description: Replacement of five antennae with six antenna apertures, two 600 mm dishes with four 600 mm dishes, and the replacement of one equipment cabinet with eight equipment cabinets on the roof and associated works.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (002 Site Location Plan, 100 Existing Site Plan, 150 Existing Elevation A, 215 Max Configuration Site Plan, 265 Max Configuration Elevation, Declaration of Conformity with ICNIRP Public Exposure Guidelines: Received 20/03/2019. 
150 Existing North Elevation, 151 Existing East Elevation,  152 Existing South Elevation,  153 Existing West Elevation,  265 Max Configuration North Elevation, 265 Max Configuration East Elevation, 267 Max Configuration South Elevation, 268 Max Configuration West Elevation: Received 12/08/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The structure, antenna, and associated facilities shall be removed if they become obsolete.
